# Cross-articulation formation matching with retained references

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Finite configurations over different fragment carriers with equal initial slot counts and agreement on all retained-reference branch questions match every finite formation command sequence under finite fixed-pair outcomes, preserving the original configuration, final answers and slot alignment. Exact accounts of the same actual process must distinguish its idle and spent histories.

Canonical source: [Joining.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joining.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- FiniteOutcomes on both sides; agreement on all finite negation, conjunction and slot-pair continuation questions; equal initial slot counts.
- Each step selects two slots in the same configuration and appends a witnessed result while retaining old slots. The concrete unavoidable-distinction theorem only needs Exact, not finiteness or Reduced.

Indices name positions internal to the configuration and can reference earlier formed results; no common native object names are supplied. Formation-arrangement semantics is not automatically execution with destructive resources.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checks 43 new declarations and 213 inherited audits, 256 total; new 9 empty and 34 standard dependency lists, 7 with classical choice. Frozen source/logs bind to the receipt; no independent-agent acceptance.

Does not establish initial question agreement for arbitrary actual articulations, acquired memory, permission to copy resources, probabilities, cycles or changes of primitive joining granularity; general recovery retains standard classical dependencies.

- 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Alike configurations of equally many slots match every course of formation, keeping where they started and keeping the slots aligned, with no finiteness and no decision (Joining.retained_history_matches); under the periphery's hypotheses with excluded middle, so do they (Joining.retained_history_matches_of_em). Here a fragment that joins with itself and one that does not are told apart by one test, and every description exact for these tests gives them different codes (retained_apart, retained_codes_apart; in the bridge every_exact_account_retains_real_difference_by_core). The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff).
